wsss4luad_04.observation: Converted RGB is exactly constant red, yet J01/L01/L02 and bending children produce different lower-left green shapes, and L02 creates scattered green islands across the field. Other methods return all red. Without any RGB class contrast, these differences are not validated architectural inference and can be numerical/spatial-prior artifacts. This blocks full launch until a common documented degenerate-evidence fallback is implemented. No algorithm is selected on this result.

decision.decision: Do not launch full cycle: implement a common constant-evidence fallback and re-pilot before full inference.
